notes.title: Celebrating the Not It: Spookiest Edition Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone~

So you enjoyed My Sweet Confession. Helped Ichika solve her love troubles with Hana, and made some chocolate along the way. But we've got a new visual novel releasing in ONE WEEK!

We're so excited that our new horror visual novel, Not It: Spookiest Edition, will be releasing in one week on Tuesday, October 12th!

To celebrate this upcoming release, we're doing a sale on all our visual novels! 

Grab our visual novels while they're on sale, and save some time in the ~spooky horror month~ of October to enjoy Not It: Spookiest Edition!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719770/Not_It_Spookiest_Edition/
